models.sql:
WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    InvoiceNo,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice,
    InvoiceDate
  FROM retail
  WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-12-01 00:00:00'
    AND InvoiceDate < '2011-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND NOT (InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' OR InvoiceNo LIKE 'c%')
    AND Quantity > 0
    AND UnitPrice > 0
    AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.CustomerID,
    SUM(ct.Quantity * ct.UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ct.InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
  FROM qualified ct
  GROUP BY ct.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  c.CustomerID,
  COALESCE(ct.revenue_pence, 0)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
  COALESCE(ct.invoice_count, 0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN customer_totals ct ON c.CustomerID = ct.CustomerID
ORDER BY c.CustomerID

WITH qualifying AS (

    CustomerID,

    InvoiceNo NOT LIKE '%c' AND

)
SELECT

  COALESCE(SUM(q.revenue_pence), 0)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo), 0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY c.CustomerID
